note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. TestRFC7854EveryTransmittedMessageCarriesVersion3AndItsTotalLength reads the transmitted octets of all seven types: octet 0 == 3 (so never the reserved 0), octets 1-4 == the whole message computed independently from the case's own inputs (common header + per-peer header where present + data) and equal to the octets the writer produced, and octet 5 == the type. Each clause of the quoted definition is asserted on a sent message. The tagged negative (header_test, a 3-octet buffer refused) is thin, but the clauses are sender field definitions with no input to refuse; the positive discriminates every one.
